ctx.x: Go marching in Oh, when the saints go marching in

This is NBC News. Goodbye, Louis, King of Jazz. This is Wilson Hall. Louis Sachmo Armstrong, jazz trumpeter, was buried today near the Queens, New York home, where he had lived for 30 years. The funeral service was held in a small, simple, red-brick congregational church in Armstrong's neighborhood. Only 500 could get into the church. 2,000 mourners stood outside in the summer's sweltering heat. Al Hibbler, an old friend and musician, recalled the old New Orleans days of Armstrong by singing, When the Saints Go…
